newsitem.title: CHINA: CCTV film production firm plans A share IPO.
newsitem.headline: CCTV film production firm plans A share IPO.

text.p: Wuxi CCTV Film and Television Productions Co Ltd, a subsidiary of China Central Television (CCTV), will issue 50 million A shares in an initial public offering (IPO) on Thursday, a company statement said.
The IPO, priced at 7.95 yuan per share, is expected to raise a net income of 388.16 million yuan, excluding an issue cost of 9.34 million yuan, the statement on Wednesday said.
A shares are reserved for Chinese nationals.
Proceeds will be used to expand CCTV's production base in Wuxi, in the province of Jiangsu, and for shooting more television series adapted from ancient Chinese classics, it said.
Set up in 1987, the company is now CCTV's largest production operation in the south of China, having produced nearly 100 movies and television plays.

A total of 47.75 million shares will be issued to the public through the computer system of the Shanghai stock exchange and the remaining 2.25 million shares will be distributed to staff members, the statement said.
After the issue, the company will have a total of 168 million outstanding shares. The remaining shares are owned by the state, it said.
China Education, Science and Technology Trust and Investment Co has been appointed the lead underwriter, it said.
